claims: According to reports, President Donald Trump fired Pam Bondi from her position as U.S. Attorney General on April 2, 2026, after 14 months.
President Donald Trump was reportedly frustrated with Pam Bondi's handling of key investigations, including the Epstein files and failure to prosecute political opponents.
President Donald Trump replaced Pam Bondi with Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche.
Todd Blanche was appointed acting Attorney General.
President Donald Trump was dissatisfied with Pam Bondi's handling of justice department investigations, particularly those involving Jeffrey Epstein and opposition figures.
The firing occurred following mounting pressure and a reported meeting at the Oval Office.
